meta.title: Margin Bonus | Up to $20,000 Extra Margin | GTCFX
meta.description: Enhance your trading power with additional margin support, giving you greater flexibility to seize market opportunities.

hero.title: What Is The [GTC Margin Bonus]?
hero.text: A Margin Bonus is a non-withdrawable and non-transferable credit issued based on your deposit amount. It increases your account's usable margin, giving you more room to trade during periods of high market volatility.
hero.warning: Important: The bonus can be lost and will not be restored if removed. It cannot be withdrawn or transferred at any point.

calculator.title: Bonus Calculator
calculator.note: Estimate only. Minimum qualifying deposit $500, bonus capped at $20,000.

steps.title: How to [Apply]
steps.description: Two steps and your bonus request is processed automatically.

items.title: Register
items.text: Register for the promotion by submitting the form on the campaign page.

items.title: Deposit
items.text: Make a qualifying deposit of at least $500 into your verified live trading account.

items.title: Get Your Bonus
items.text: Once both steps are completed, your bonus request will be automatically processed.

items.title: Registered Clients Only
items.text: Only registered clients will be eligible to receive the bonus.

terms.title: Terms & [Conditions]
terms.description: Everything you need to know before you claim the GTC Margin Bonus.

sections.title: Eligibility
points: The Promotion is available exclusively to clients with fully verified live trading accounts.

items: First-time deposits of at least $500 made by new clients.
Top-up deposits by existing clients, applied only to the newly deposited amount.

points: The Promotion is available on all account types, except for Cent accounts.
Each client may participate once, unless otherwise authorized in writing.
Clients trading via MAM, PAMM, or Social Trading are not eligible.
The bonus is a non-losing bonus used exclusively to support margin. It does not constitute real balance and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

sections.title: Bonus Size and Structure

points.text: The bonus amount is calculated as:
items: 50% of the deposit amount for deposits up to $10,000

points: The maximum total bonus per client is capped at $20,000.
To receive the bonus, the client must first register for the promotion and then make a qualifying deposit.
Once registered and funded, the bonus request will be automatically generated and processed.

sections.title: Cashback Conditions
points: Clients who receive the Margin Bonus are eligible to claim $3 per full lot traded on FX pairs, gold, metals, and oil within a 3-month period.

points.text: Cashback can be requested only once and to qualify:
items: The cashback amount must be at least $500
It must represent at least 20% of the bonus received

points: The total cashback is capped at the value of the bonus received.
Cashback must be requested through the client's personal account manager.
Cashback will be credited within 7 business days once approved.

items.text: If a client receives a $2,500 bonus, they must trade at least ~167 lots to earn $500 in cashback.
If a client receives a $3,000 bonus and trades only ~133 lots to earn $400 cashback.
If a client receives a $1,000 bonus, they must trade at least ~167 lots to earn $500 cashback, which is over 50% of the bonus.
If a client receives a $5,000 bonus and trades 100 lots to earn $300 cashback.

sections.title: Bonus Use and Nature

points.text: The Margin Bonus is strictly for trading margin support and cannot be:
items: Used as tradable or real account balance

points: Any withdrawal from the client's account will result in automatic removal of the bonus.

sections.title: Withdrawal Conditions
points: GTCFX reserves the right to remove the bonus if the account equity falls below the bonus amount.
Once removed, the bonus will not be reinstated under any circumstances.

sections.title: Bonus Expiry
points: The Margin Bonus is valid for up to 3 months from the date of the first qualifying deposit.
GTCFX may remove the bonus automatically after the 3-month period, regardless of trading activity.
If cashback conditions are not met within the 3-month period, eligibility for cashback is forfeited.

points.text: Abuse of the promotion is strictly prohibited. Examples include:
items: Hedging between multiple accounts or brokers
Latency arbitrage or other technical exploits
Remove the bonus without prior notice
Cancel cashback or profits obtained through abusive behavior
Suspend or terminate client accounts involved in fraud or abuse

sections.title: Stop Out Policy
points: If the account equity reaches the stop-out level, or if the floating loss equals the actual account balance, the Margin Bonus will be automatically removed.

sections.title: Client Acknowledgment
points: By accepting the Margin Bonus, the client acknowledges and agrees to these Terms & Conditions.
Misuse of the Promotion may result in the removal of the bonus, forfeiture of profits, and/or suspension of the trading account.

apply.title: Apply for the [Margin Bonus]
apply.text: Verify your e-mail, enter your live account number and deposit amount, and your bonus request is processed automatically.
notes: To claim cashback, reach out directly to your Personal Account Manager once the trading and eligibility requirements are fulfilled.
For assistance, contact your Account Manager or the GTCFX Support Team.
